description: The harness stops at approved drafts; a human commits, pushes and opens the PR/MR on any platform.

review.instructions: Paste or export the review comments into a markdown file and pass it to `sdlc handback`.

steps: sdlc ship-request --ticket <id> --repo <repo>  (show the full request to the user)
sdlc ship --ticket <id> --repo <repo> --approve <requestDigest>  (only after the user approves that exact request)
ship.note: kaneki-ship stages exactly the reviewed files, commits as git.user, and stops there: a person pushes and opens the PR/MR on any platform.

steps: after the review round reaches deliverable-ready again: ship-request, approval, ship (same branch; the push updates the open PR)
